default.description: Default capability for the GaugeDesk window. `core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom` is what makes the shell's browser-style zoom (Ctrl +/-/0 and Ctrl+wheel, injected by `ZOOM_HOTKEYS` in main.rs) do anything: the hotkeys reach the webview through `set_webview_zoom`, and `core:default` does not grant that command — without it they are silently inert.
